name: Palantir
coverage_note: P024 uses pseudotime as a selected-root comparator; P094 uses multiscale diffusion space upstream of scFates. Editions and complete preprocessing remain unreported. Credit requires the separate exact original coordinate-workflow evidence.

name: scFates
coverage_note: P094 reports distinct200-node UMAP and3000-node diffusion-space SimplePPT fits. Generic graph distance and the upstream Palantir adapter do not implement scFates fitting.

name: SAW
coverage_note: Uppercase SAW is the named Stereo-seq pipeline. P117 reports7.0.0/GRCh38; P094 leaves its edition unstated. Source, license and runtime require separate review before permitted installation.

name: Stereopy
coverage_note: P094 reports0.12.1 h5ad conversion; P117 reports1.1.0 GEF-to-AnnData plus a separate R script for Seurat. These editions, schemas and conversion stages are not interchangeable.

name: DoRothEA
coverage_note: P169 reuses regulatory evidence alongside OmniPath. It does not demonstrate a DoRothEA/VIPER activity fit; the resource snapshot and confidence selection remain unspecified.
